description: This file defines classes related to network information, including routing tables, network adapters, and IP address iterators within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes class declarations for RoutingTable, AdapterObserver, IPV4AddressIterator, IPV6AddressIterator, and AdapterIterator, along with associated methods and data members.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents a network routing table with methods to manage routes.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a single route entry within the routing table, including source, destination, gateway, and other routing parameters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observes network adapter events and provides notifications.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterates over IPv4 addresses associated with a network adapter.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterates over IPv6 addresses associated with a network adapter (Windows-specific implementation).

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to their properties such as name, MAC address, and IP addresses.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Source
methods.description: Returns the source node ID of the route.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Destination
methods.description: Returns the destination node ID of the route.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Gateway
methods.description: Returns the gateway node ID for the route.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Preferred
methods.description: Returns the preferred node ID for the route.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Metrics
methods.description: Returns the metrics associated with the route.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the route.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Interface
methods.description: Returns the interface name associated with the route.

methods.name: AdapterObserver::Open
methods.description: Opens the adapter observer to start receiving events.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next IPv4 address.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address the iterator points to.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.
